title: Shut Down OptiSweep System Through the WCS API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API client to confirm that the system is in the running state, execute POST System Shutdown, and verify that GET System State reports shutdown.
when_to_use: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API when an authorized L2 or L3 support user needs to shut down the OptiSweep system from its live running state and verify the resulting system state.
not_for: Do not use POST System Shutdown unless GET System State confirms that the system is running.
Do not use this procedure as a physical emergency stop or a substitute for site safety actions.
Do not use this procedure when the API request cannot be executed or returns an unrecognized result; escalate instead.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support or L3_support performs the API state checks and shutdown request using the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
The executing support role verifies the post-request system state and escalates when the state does not change or the result is unrecognized.
safety_notes: Confirm the current system state before issuing the shutdown request.
POST System Shutdown is described as shutting down the system when it is in a running state.

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent approved API client.
L2_support or L3_support authorization to execute the shutdown operation.
system_preconditions: GET System State must report running before POST System Shutdown is executed.

steps.title: Open the System Shutdown request in the WCS API client
steps.purpose: Locate the live shutdown operation before checking or changing system state.
steps.instruction: Open the OptiSweep / WCS API in Apidog or an equivalent approved API client and locate POST System Shutdown in the System API list.
steps.expected_result: The POST System Shutdown request is available in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
steps.healthy_condition: The System API list contains POST System Shutdown and GET System State.
steps.failure_condition: The API client cannot be opened, the System API list is unavailable, or POST System Shutdown cannot be located.

actions.label: Locate System Shutdown
actions.exact_action: Locate POST System Shutdown in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the API request cannot be executed or POST System Shutdown is not available.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OptiSweep provides APIs to get data and make requests; Apidog is installed on the primary servers.
The System API list includes GET System State and POST System Shutdown.

steps.title: Verify the current state through the WCS API
steps.purpose: Ensure the shutdown operation is being applied from the supported running state.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep / WCS API client, execute GET System State and inspect the returned current system state. Continue only when the returned state is running.
steps.expected_result: GET System State returns the current system state as running.
steps.healthy_condition: The live WCS API response identifies the system state as running.
steps.failure_condition: The returned state is not running, the request fails, or the response is unrecognized.

actions.label: Get current system state
actions.exact_action: Execute GET System State and confirm that the returned state is running.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if GET System State does not report running.
Escalate if GET System State cannot be executed or returns an unrecognized result.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: System State gets the current state of the system. System Shutdown shuts down the system if it is in a running state.

steps.title: Execute System Shutdown and query state again
steps.purpose: Issue the supported WCS API shutdown operation and obtain a live post-operation state.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep / WCS API client, execute POST System Shutdown. After the request completes, execute GET System State again.
steps.expected_result: The shutdown request completes and a subsequent GET System State response is available for verification.
steps.healthy_condition: POST System Shutdown can be executed while the pre-request state is running, and GET System State returns a recognized state.
steps.failure_condition: The POST request cannot be executed, returns an unrecognized result, or no subsequent system-state response is available.

actions.label: Recheck system state
actions.exact_action: Execute GET System State again after the shutdown request.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the API request cannot be executed or returns an unrecognized result.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: System Shutdown shuts down the system if it is in a running state; System State gets the current state.

steps.title: Confirm the shutdown state
steps.purpose: Verify that the live system state changed to the documented shutdown state.
steps.instruction: Inspect the state returned by the post-request GET System State call and compare it with the documented shutdown state.
steps.expected_result: The post-request GET System State response reports shutdown.
steps.healthy_condition: The live WCS API state is shutdown after POST System Shutdown.
steps.failure_condition: The live WCS API state does not change to shutdown or the returned state is unrecognized.

actions.label: Verify shutdown state
actions.exact_action: Compare the returned state with the shutdown state.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the system state does not change to shutdown after the shutdown request.
Escalate if the returned state is unrecognized.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: System Startup starts the system from a shutdown state, and System Shutdown shuts down the system from a running state.

success_criteria: GET System State reports running before the shutdown request.
A subsequent GET System State reports shutdown.
healthy_conditions: The OptiSweep / WCS API client exposes GET System State and POST System Shutdown.
The pre-operation system state is running.
The post-operation system state is shutdown.
failure_conditions: The system is not in the running state before POST System Shutdown.
The API request cannot be executed.
The API returns an unrecognized result.
The system state does not change to shutdown after the request.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate when the pre-shutdown state is not running.
Escalate when the API request cannot be executed or returns an unrecognized result.
Stop and escalate when the post-request system state does not change to shutdown.
